name: Docs
description: The docs library app (forge 35a-2): pages, each a document file in a Volume, in a tree per Volume held in the page records, with icons, covers, templates, favourites and a trash purged after trashDays. A Volume's grants are the floor of who may read and change its pages. Forge's Docs app requires it for its pages.

commands.title: Add a page
commands.description: Adds the record of a page whose document file createPage has just made: args {volume, file, parent?, title?, template?}; use the createPage tool, which makes the file first

commands.title: Move a page
commands.description: Moves the target page with its subpages under parent (the top level when left out), between the siblings after and before; never into its own subtree

commands.title: Put a page in the trash
commands.description: Puts the target page and its subpages in the trash, as one batch

commands.title: Restore a page
commands.description: Brings the target page back from the trash with the subpages trashed with it; to the top of its Volume when its parent is gone

queries.name: tree
queries.description: The subpages of one page, or a Volume's top level, in order, outside the trash: params {volume, parent?}

queries.name: favourites
queries.description: The caller's favourite pages in their order

queries.name: trash
queries.description: A Volume's trash, newest first: params {volume}

tools.name: createPage
tools.title: Create a page
tools.description: Makes a page in a Volume, under parent or at the top, empty or from a template page: its document file and its record, in one request; gives the page's id

tools.name: purgePage
tools.title: Delete a page forever
tools.description: Deletes a page in the trash for good, with the subpages trashed with it: their document files and records

roles.title: Docs admin
roles.description: Uses Docs and manages every page of the Volumes they may change

roles.title: Docs user
roles.description: Uses Docs: reads the pages of the Volumes they may read and changes those of the Volumes they may change, and keeps their own favourites

trashDays.title: Days in the trash
trashDays.description: How many days a page stays in the trash before it is deleted for good

triggers.title: Old trash is purged
triggers.description: Every day, deletes for good the pages in the trash longer than trashDays
